column3: Setup: Use the journal_form testdrive - it supplies admin_1 and admin_2 (both can open the same journal) and a primary_journal with no existing notes. OR prepare two admin accounts and a shared journal yourself.
Setup: Important: the testdrive page tears down its data as soon as you navigate away from it. Run the test in a separate browser tab/window, leaving the testdrive tab open until you have finished.
Use admin_1 and admin_2 from the testdrive setup; both can open the primary_journal at its admin_form URL (/admin/journal/<id>)
Go to the primary journal's admin form at `/admin/journal/<id>`

column4: New note UI is displayed for you to fill in
The note is saved and displayed in the list of notes
you username and user id will be showed on that note
the date and time you created the note will be shown

column3: Click into the note field and edit the note
Create a new note as per the above steps
Switch to the other admin account `admin_2` (a separate private window is easiest)
Go to the same journal's admin form at `/admin/journal/<id>`

column4: You can see the note that you have created before with `admin_1`

column3: Attempt to click into the note area and edit it

column4: you are unable to edit the note
You are unable to delete the note

column3: Click "copy" button next to one of the fields (eg. Title)

column4: Confirmation with fields value is displayed for 3 seconds

column3: Attempt to paste the value (use separate editor)
